definitions: Findings below preserve original independent reviewer IDs and original severity/classification. The previous certificate reused IDs for different topics; do not treat them as equivalent.

findings.original_title: Approval-store predictable temporary file permits a symlink clobber in a writable store directory
findings.disposition: Private directory descriptors, O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL random temp names, replay tests; independent macOS hostile-parent revalidation not performed by this reviewer.

findings.original_title: Process-group cleanup cannot enforce complete descendant containment
findings.disposition: Untrusted target execution disabled. The detached setsid() limitation is not actually eliminated by process-group cleanup.

findings.original_title: Declared Git revision is not bound to executable source content at dispatch
findings.disposition: No untrusted subprocess dispatch is reachable; binding executable bytes still necessary if capability is ever re-enabled.

findings.original_title: Observation action does not require execution-spec authorization while adapter accepts command dispatch
findings.disposition: observe/staging cannot invoke subprocess; independent host-attestation contract review remains advisable.

findings.original_title: Resource limits omit memory, disk, file-descriptor and process-count quotas
findings.disposition: No untrusted execution permitted; memory/disk/PID quotas are not implemented and must not be advertised.

findings.original_title: Mandatory 45 authenticated A/B/C trials absent from independently available evidence
findings.disposition: Only three developer-reported multi-project sessions; zero independent per-case trials authenticated by this review.

findings.original_title: Condition C is identified by a mutable branch rather than an immutable evaluated Skill revision
findings.disposition: Metrics now name frozen 0f223...; original session cannot be independently linked to executed code bytes.

findings.original_title: Runtime matrix is stale and contains a timestamp later than its own containing commit
findings.disposition: Prior record retained and developer explanation documented; later macOS matrix references e9a500... but host provenance is not independently attested here.

findings.original_title: Benchmark target revisions and independent ground truth cannot be independently inspected
findings.disposition: Immutable claimed target SHA strings and ground-truth summaries exist, but target bytes, independent label adjudication and raw trial provenance remain unavailable.

findings.original_title: Legacy Markdown report can display scoped all-clear from unauthenticated synthetic PASS records
findings.disposition: Legacy report clamps positive message to conditional; regression in CI, no independent authenticated report test conducted here.

findings.original_title: Release metadata and protocol documents disagree with requested v0.5.0 baseline
findings.disposition: Release is still a v0.5.0-rc1 candidate; published stable metadata must be aligned only after formal authorization.

findings.original_title: Telemetry sanitization protects command argv but logs unredacted destination and paths
findings.disposition: Destination and paths hashed in events; review complete telemetry surfaces before claiming full privacy.

findings.original_title: No independent macOS Seatbelt run or authentic target/evaluation evidence for this review
findings.disposition: Developer-generated 10-test macOS matrix exists for e9a500... but this reviewer did not execute on Mac or authenticate host-originated logs; evaluation evidence incomplete.

findings.original_title: Model supplied JSON cannot by itself forge HostAttestation in assess()
findings.disposition: Host callback and digest binding are checked; threat requires a separate compromised or over-permissive trusted host.

findings.original_title: Claim that all GitHub Actions checks were skipped or never executed is rejected
findings.disposition: GitHub Actions run 43756365960: 286 total / 254 passed / 32 skipped / 0 failed; integration job separately succeeded.
